chunks: ʿAlī ibn Mahzīyār narrated from Faḍālah ibn Ayyūb, from Abān ibn ʿUthmān, from Abī Baṣīr, who said:
Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said: “Whoever adds to his salat (prayer), then repetition is incumbent upon him.”

key_terms.الْإِعَادَةُ: repetition of the act, here meaning repeating the prayer
key_terms.زَادَ: added something extra beyond what is legislated
key_terms.صَلَاتِهِ: his salat (prayer), referring to the prescribed ritual prayer

ai.seo_question: If someone adds an extra act in salat (prayer), must the prayer be repeated?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling regarding salat (prayer): adding something extra to the prayer necessitates repeating it. It is a concise jurisprudential report found in the chapter on mistakes and forgetfulness in salat.
